question:
**Consider the following statements:**

**Statement 1**. Qutub-ud-din Aibak established the Slave Dynasty after the death of Mohammad Ghori.

**Statement 2**. The Delhi Sultanate began with the rule of Balban, one of the notable rulers of the Khalji dynasty.

Which of the statements given above **is/are correct?**
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• **Statement 1:** Qutub-ud-din Aibak established the Slave Dynasty after the death of Mohammad Ghori.__ This statement is **correct**. 
 __
 
• Qutub-ud-din Aibak was a former slave of **Muhammad Ghori**, who later rose to power after Ghori's death in **1206**. 
 
• He laid the foundation of the **Slave Dynasty** (also known as the Mamluk Dynasty), which was the first dynasty of the **Delhi Sultanate**. 
 
• He was known for his contribution to architecture, including the construction of the famous **Qutub Minar** in Delhi. 
 
 

 
• **Statement 2:** The Delhi Sultanate began with the rule of Balban, one of the notable rulers of the Khalji dynasty.__ This statement is **incorrect**.
